description: Full detail for one UK appeal by its case reference — a PINS case number (England) or a PEDW, DPEA or PAC reference (Wales, Scotland, Northern Ireland): nation, LPA, appeal type and reason, procedure, decision and all key dates, the linked LPA application reference, and whether we hold the decision letter. Also serves appeals known only from the decision letter a council published with the application (source=council_archive, fields read from the letter), and such a letter by its letter_id ('letter:…', the id an appeal whose letter states no readable case number is served under). An appeal in England that is not decided yet is served too, from its page on the Inspectorate's portal: stage says where it is (e.g. 'Open for comments'), with its council, procedure, application reference, comment deadline and any inquiry or hearing date, and no decision. Bounded record, no inspector name. 404 if the case is not in our capture.

pins_case_number.description: the appeal's case reference at its appeals body: a PINS case number in England ('3247743'; 'TPO-9586' for a tree preservation order appeal), 'CAS-…' in Wales, a DPEA reference in Scotland ('PPA-270-2306'), a PAC reference in Northern Ireland ('2025/L0002') — or, for an appeal known only from a council-archive letter whose case number could not be read, the letter's id ('letter:0123456789abcdef')
pins_case_number.title: Pins Case Number
